name: Greenwood
gaps: Source query returned 5342 rows; 5341 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels (Parcels_Search_and_Select) (https://www.greenwoodsc.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Operational_Layers/Parcels_Search_and_Select/MapServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Sales_Points is point-based and includes invalid/zero-price source records; it is not a complete parcel sale-history table.
Greenwood Area/Area_SqFt aliases and observed numeric values require unit validation before converting to acreage.
No stable PIN-specific assessor deep link verified; use official GIS Quick Search with PIN={parcelId}.
Reject SCDOT SC_Parcels token-walled services as a primary source; county MapServer above is public and preferred.
